'''Amador''' is the capital city of [[Amadicia]]. It is also where the [[Children of the Light]] have their [[Fortress of the Light|main fortress]].{{ref/book|1|13}} Even though Amador is part of Amadicia the king is not the true ruler of the city. It is one of the large cities in the Westlands that was neither built by [[Ogier]] nor founded on an Ogier-built city. It is currently under [[Seanchan]] occupation.

==History==
Amador was founded after the [[Trolloc Wars]].

==Allusions==
"Amador" is derived from the Latin word for "lover" or "someone who loves".
